name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: An edge-anchored layer with real swipe and snap-point support, built on Base UI's Drawer primitive. Consumes the layer family directly (panel, header, body, footer, title, description) but is not built from createLayerParts — it has its own Viewport, Handle and a transform-based positioning model. The inline edges invert under RTL. This is why sheet does not exist: an edge-anchored dialog and a drawer are the same component.
